study.question: Can removing execution of mathematically fixed embedding maps recover the compact model quality/cost deficit, and is the effect different at raw table widths 8 and 16 under unchanged interaction width 16?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: the unchanged compressed context-only source has click AUC 0.660646940486458. Direct half-width embeddings reached 0.6577818495793547, dense-half 0.6594732894200026 and both-half 0.6581939949883804; simple capacity cuts did not preserve its quality. Random square projections reached 0.6583135921179614, aligned trainable square maps 0.6600539774138401, and freezing I16 maps improved to 0.6605815720315062. At width8, freezing aligned duplication gave 0.6589510750537622 versus trainable 0.6589788731410577: no corresponding recovery. Thus prior trainability support is width-dependent and the half-storage deficit remains unresolved. Implementation inspection shows frozen identity/duplication still executes Linear under bf16 autocast. Provisional mechanism: extra map execution and associated dtype/gradient rounding may cause part of the remaining deficit or cost. Structural copying preserves the same real-valued fixed map and rank, removes those Linear calls, and can test that composite explanation without altering frozen precision policy. The small full-width residual and large compact residual make a complete compact recovery uncertain; a null is informative. No priority or architecture novelty is claimed.

study.proposed_difference: One operator intervention at each of two storage widths: bypass fixed square I16 maps; implement fixed [I8;I8] by one torch.cat that repeats each individual field piece twice in field order. Apply at the same post-compression locations to context, target and history values. No detach, dtype cast, autocast override, extra loss, new information, changed pooling or changed gradient routing. Keep uncalled frozen maps registered for identical state/RNG/parameter accounting within each pair. Four standalone modules form a width-by-operator factorial with two exact ancestor replays. This removes map execution, not their storage; the compact savings come from the already-halved embedding tables.
predictions: Host preflight, before training: at common weights and no autocast, map and copy outputs and input gradients agree within FP32 numerical tolerance; at width8 expected field order is [field0,field0,field1,field1,...]. Full-width copy forward matches unchanged source for common trainable weights and buffers. Paired constructors have identical state and RNG state.

Under the actual host bf16 autocast, map and copy paths may have different intermediate dtypes and rounding; record context/target/history/interactions dtypes and output/gradient discrepancies rather than assume bitwise equivalence. No differences in padding support, label visibility, mask population, source ownership or scorer buffer updates are permitted.

If fixed map arithmetic is consequential, copy8 or copy16 improves paired validation click AUC; an AUC difference >=0.0002 is the predeclared practical follow-up threshold. A compact-specific effect appears in the difference-in-differences, but a single seed supplies preliminary evidence only.

Both compact variants retain expected total storage16166277 parameters, of which15896608 are embeddings; both full-width variants retain32065317 total and31793216 embeddings. These are ancestor-derived expectations pending host counts; unused frozen maps are included. Compact saving versus the unchanged source is approximately49.6%.

Removing several small Linear calls may improve model-only latency, but copying can increase memory traffic and preserve higher-precision downstream tensors. Require measured p50/p95 and end-to-end throughput; no speedup is guaranteed.

Exploratory diagnostic reporting uses pre-existing history bins empty,1-16,17-64,>64 with samples and positive/negative counts. Other hour/composition/frequency/unseen-field slices are only evaluated by the host if already authorized and available; no unavailable raw inputs are reconstructed. Report all four task AUC/Logloss and auxiliary mean separately.
falsifiers: Any mismatch in initialization, RNG state or optimizer membership within a same-width pair beyond the intended method behavior, incorrect field order, loss of input gradients, unmasked padded influence, label leakage, nonfinite outputs/gradients or altered Dice state ownership invalidates attribution and must stop execution for repair; it is an implementation failure, not scientific counterevidence.

If operator AUC differences are below0.0002 in magnitude at both widths, the proposed practically consequential quality explanation is unsupported in this single-seed screen. A compact source gap exceeding0.0002 after copying falsifies quality retention in the tested configuration even if arithmetic has a smaller effect.

No measured p50/p95 latency benefit, or increased end-to-end inference cost, falsifies the corresponding efficiency prediction. Lower embedding parameter count alone cannot establish faster inference.

If only full-width copying recovers quality while compact copying still loses, the result does not rescue half-storage retention. If later authorized paired seeds reverse the effect or the quality/cost gate fails, robust retention is unsupported.
Any claimed saving obtained by omitting the registered frozen maps from total parameter counts, changing host precision/training exposure or consulting withheld outcomes is inadmissible.
alternative_explanations: Width8 may lack useful representation rank under this recipe irrespective of map arithmetic; width changes can also alter random initialization and embedding Adagrad geometry. This study does not distinguish those explanations.

The previous full-width benefit from freezing may reflect trainable-map learning-rate/clipping/optimization interactions; the negligible compact freezing change limits generalization. New copying outcomes must not erase those trajectories.

Structural copying changes forward dtype promotion, backward gradient casting and memory behavior together. No pure quantization or numerical-precision mechanism is identified without a later discriminating experiment.

Dice population statistics, batch order, seed effects, host scheduling and measurement drift may explain small metric/cost differences. Identical paired constructors address initialization/RNG within width; audit host sample order and source comparisons separately.

The inherited context-only source has markedly weaker auxiliary-task AUC than baseline-din (source cart/fav/buy about0.664/0.710/0.669 versus0.849/0.865/0.870). This study preserves that routing to isolate source click efficiency; no improvement can be called an all-task gain without reporting this tradeoff.

No open scoped-memory hits were returned for projection/capacity queries. Supplied receipts are direct local evidence; original external paper effectiveness does not transfer automatically. Task validator validate_task.py is named in the task but is not an authorized registered reference (resolve failed); no task-validator result or torch numerical check is claimed. Host preflight is still required.
